card.name: Drug interaction monitoring text
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction passages about monitoring blood levels of a co-given drug, and inside the names of the interacting drugs (warfarin, itraconazole, theophylline, quetiapine).

modes.label: Monitoring blood levels
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'levels' in phrases about monitoring drug concentrations.
modes.example: Frequent monitoring of trough blood<< levels>> of cyclosporine and tac

modes.label: Inside interacting drug names
modes.description: Middle or end pieces of drug names in interaction tables or sentences.
modes.example: Ketoconazole , itraconazole ↑ Ketoconazole ↑ Itra<<con>>azole Increase monitoring for adverse events.
